component.name: Restorm
component.summary: Local-first API testing environment — client and server

description.p: Restorm is a local-first environment to test APIs end to end: it is both an API client and a server. Send and inspect requests, mock and simulate endpoints, and chain reproducible scenarios across REST, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket, Redis, AMQP, MQTT and more.
Everything stays on your own disk — no forced cloud account, no telemetry on your traffic — and is Git-friendly for teams.
